chapter: War years, Decca records and La Conga
title: World War II draft takes his musicians
summary: The draft took band members; Pin Madera left first and was replaced by the Filipino Amado Punzalan.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: The war came along, World War II, and the draft took a lot of your musicians.
What did you do? How did you, Did you feel very bad about having them replaced? Could you get good replacements?
All right. Pin Madera was the first to leave.
Pin Madera was the first one.
Who did you get to replace him? Do you remember?
Yes, ahh, Amado Punzalan, a Phillipino.
